mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 41 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park under clear skies with a first quarter moon. Expect an overnight low of 32 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is hosting a public meeting regarding the Military Ridge State Trail paving project on December 8 at the Senior Center. Also, residents are reminded to keep trash and recycling carts clear of obstructions for Pellitteri collection services.
Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with trivia options including Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a report covering the first half of the month, police noted an incident on November 4 where a driver was arrested for O W I in a business parking lot with a child passenger.
Chocolate Volcano is the flavor of the day at Culver's, and the shop is open until 10 PM, so there is still time to stop by for a treat.
